---
title: "R code to generate Individual patient trajectory plot"
output: html_document
params:
    continuous_data: NA
    no_doseD: NA
    func_D: NA
    final_tD: NA
    idD: NA
    continuous_date: NA
    title: NA
    titlesize: NA
    axissize: 30
    x_lab: "Timepoint" 
    y_lab: "Score in PRO domain" 
    arrow_lab: "Better \n tolerability" 
    range: c(0,100) 
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(ggh4x)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(gridExtra)
library(survminer)

print(params[-1])

continuous_data <- params$continuous_data
no_doseD <- params$no_doseD
func_D <- params$func_D
final_tD <- params$final_tD
idD <- params$idD
continuous_date <- params$continuous_date


if(continuous_date == TRUE){
    continuous_data$timepoint == as.Date(continuous_data$timepoint)
}
  
continuous_data <- continuous_data %>%
    filter(dose %in% no_doseD) %>%
    filter(id %in% idD) %>%
    filter(timepoint <= final_tD) %>%
    filter(functioning == func_D) %>%
    filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-functioning)
continuous_data <- data.frame(continuous_data)

labels_D <- paste0("ID ", continuous_data$id, " (Dose: ", continuous_data$dose, ")")

continuous_data$dose <- as.factor(continuous_data$dose)

lims <- params$range
minval <- min(continuous_data$score, na.rm = TRUE)
maxval <- max(continuous_data$score, na.rm = TRUE)
lower <- min(c(minval, lims[1]))
upper <- max(c(maxval, lims[2]))

ggplot(data = continuous_data, aes(x = as.factor(timepoint),
                                   y = score, group = id, colour = labels_D, linetype = dose)) +
      geom_line(size = 0.9) +
      labs(linetype = "Dose") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
      ylim(c(lower, upper)) +
      geom_point() +
      labs(
            y = params$y_lab,
            x = params$x_lab,
            color = "Patient (Dose)") +
      ggtitle(params$title) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = params$titlesize, face = "bold"), axis.title = element_text(size = params$axissize)) +
      geom_segment(x = 0.2, xend = 0.2, y = lower, yend = upper,
                   colour = "darkgrey", size = 0.8, arrow = arrow(type = "closed",
                                                                  length = unit(0.1, "inches")), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      geom_text(x = -0.2, y = upper * 0.9, label = params$arrow_lab, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(2, 0)))
```
